Seed_Methodology_Note: METHODOLOGICAL NOTE: The 5-seed evaluation quantifies stochastic noise in the EV demand generation process at inference time. DDPG policy training was verified for convergence via reward curves (Stage 3) but was NOT independently retrained per seed due to compute constraints. Reported std values should be interpreted as evaluation-noise bounds, not training-variance bounds.
